{{Quote|You've never faced Quesoth Soldiers in battle. We, on the other hand, have dealt with them both as allies and as enemies. They're bigger even than the Workers—when they rear up they're nearly as tall as you or I—and immensely strong. They're also fiercely loyal to their Queen, obeying her orders unquestioningly and with no consideration for their own safety. And there are thousands of them within the Red City.|[[Nyama]], to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Soldiers''' were a caste of the [[Quesoth]], an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The Soldiers had little intelligence and were fiercely loyal to the Quesoth [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], who communicated with the Soldiers via the language [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]], although the Soldiers lacked the vocal capacity to speak Soldier Speak themselves. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Empire of the Hand]] launched an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on Quethold and Imperial forces engaged a large group of Soldiers in combat on the edge of the [[Red City]]. The Soldiers were led by a commander.
